direction: forward along the hall's long axis, from just inside the corner entrance toward the glass table, the camera leading her and keeping her in frame the whole way
speed: about 0.8 m/s — roughly six metres of the hall's 31.7 m covered in the eight seconds, slow enough to read the vault and the lamp row
start_frame: Just inside the corner entrance: Alice stepping in under its 2.45 m lintel, framed against the near end of the shallow vault, the hall beyond her still only a dark length under a receding row of gilt-haloed lamps with amber tulip shades.
end_frame: Further down the hall on the same axis: the full 2.80 m height of the faded gilded vault and its verdigris whiplash ribs, the iron lily-stems and mosaic dado, the horseshoe-arched oak doors with their unlit roundels running away both sides, the glass table catching light far ahead and the far end lost in darkness — Alice small against all of it, and no Rabbit anywhere.
constraint_honoured: 'The episode's one hall reveal: 31.7 m of length and the 2.80 m vault registered in the SAME shot, not in a cut' — one continuous forward move does that; the roundels are passed as faint jewel glints only and never backlit.
movement_note: Licensed move (b), the single hall reveal, spent here. One move type only — forward travel, no tilt, no height change, no lateral drift — and eight seconds is exactly enough for it at a walking pace.
